paragraphs: California Gold Nutrition® Omega-3 Fish Oil contains two Omega-3 fatty acids, known as EPA and DHA which are polyunsaturated fats, also known as good fats. It’s important to incorporate an adequate amount of good fats into your diet as they may support cardiovascular health.* These good fats can be found naturally in many types of seafood, and a fish oil supplement makes it convenient to get the recommended dose.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 softgel daily, with food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Pregnant or lactating women, the chronically ill, elderly, individuals under the age of 18, those taking prescription medications (e.g ., blood thinners) as well as those with a physician-diagnosed medical condition should consult with a physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
